reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 55 for the 220-receiver graph. The lower bound is an independent set of size 55 (check passed). The upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_3 of length 55 that meets it, and the fit, factorization and decoding checks all passed. The agent used 1 code and 0.044 s of compute, but wall time was 37.463 s, almost all of it LLM time (37.419 s). On accuracy it matched the kushagra_agent baseline (55/55, field 3), which took only 0.033 s, so the agent lost badly on time. It beat cpsat_cover (65, unproven after 120 s) and f2_minrank_sat (no value, lower 54). frac_cover (55, 29.2 s) and cpsat_alpha (55, 0.61 s) only bound one side. Nothing suspicious.
